<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Policy and Growth:</strong> The RBI has maintained the repo rate, while projecting a real GDP growth of 6.9% for the current fiscal year.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOTGFSNzg0VzlJdnMwYWh2TzliX3libXhnd0pFajdsbW05R3dZU3Y5V3BjRU5uV2Q0aDVOZWZNX3dDdHpvNXpGOXRTQlNnQVRScklzNU5QdjVmV2YzOWlFVWZXMXFSZWxscFJIdFY0UHhleHZreWhkRmhqNGpCeTBYTVlpZ3AxcFN5X0h6SkFqSHJzSTBhWER6N1lkQXB3cnlLRXU4TF95ZjNWdC01XzBkTm0zOGN3RmpXc1lQSkdR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Performance:</strong> Indian benchmark indices snapped a two-week winning streak, with the Nifty falling 0.8% and the Sensex shedding 490 points, pressured by rising crude oil prices and profit-booking.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory Review:</strong> SEBI is conducting a review of the new closing auction system following feedback regarding liquidity and trading concerns.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Inflation and Liquidity:</strong> India&#x27;s WPI inflation eased to 9.78% in July, even as the RBI prepares to close the FCNR(B) swap facility early following $52.3 billion in inflows.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Geopolitical Risks:</strong> Markets remain sensitive to global uncertainty, with crude oil prices fluctuating due to concerns surrounding the Strait of Hormuz.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxQRUlIOTlfZW9mZG1sQzFXNmpxYi16WEgzZ2pReTMxcmlJRVBBT3Jxd2l1eG0yLUdZY0JQc0huOVVPekxZRUkxU1FpUGhmUGd0TVFDUjFHRmJUQVZnNjEyTjc3eTREY0NXbkZva0pKYXY1TjJSV2gzVmRjeHlRZWVaZHk3SHJXd1E1NXNmVFlBSnFkcEd1aUFnb3FnT1Q3SWFNSDkyd1JzNFFjOWdQM1dv?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
